public_rationale: The evidence distinguishes conventional workloads and public research projects from commercial AI demand. Neither construction activity nor workload counts establish that causal dependence.
limitations: The assessment adopts the commercial AI scope supplied by the surrounding discussion.
A broader reading would require separate treatment of conventional computing and public research demand.
The searched records do not provide the required counterfactual funding and payment evidence.
